_comment: THE per-site identity file — the only file that changes between loisirs74/73/38/…  Engine scripts read it via scripts/siteconfig.py and must never hardcode these values. department.name_i18n overrides the department name per language; absent languages fall back to department.name.
_promo_link_comment: Hosts the publisher promotes and OWNS — marked rel=sponsored wherever they appear. NO money is involved anywhere on this site; 'sponsored' is the correct marker for promotion, not only for paid links, and self-promotion across hundreds of pages is still advertising. This list is a belt-and-braces second rule: mark_sponsored_links.py already qualifies EVERY link inside a partner card structurally, host-agnostic, so a new card cannot escape by using a new domain. Editorial source citations — the venue's own site, offices de tourisme, mairies, patrimoine databases — are deliberately absent and stay FOLLOWED: they are the evidence layer.
_sister_comment: Armed 2026-08-16 — loisirs73.fr live, verified. count+highlights feed the homepage card's 'what you'll find' line; refresh count from loisirs73.fr/api/lieux.json when it grows, swap highlights at will. Remove the block to disarm everything.
